authority: Codex visual judgments from decoded source sheets, sampled native contexts, and sampled gameplay frame sequences. QA11 acceptance is a separate gate. The 4.6 floor is per image and scores are never averaged. Each sheet cell is one unique decoded bitmap, including all keyed regions listed in the inventory. Shared foyer backgrounds and unrelated Opera career images lie outside the arcade bitmap inventory; the actual elevator approach and return were captured.
